Lasso a group of buttons by encircling them. Start a lasso by holding your finger or clicking in an open space, then moving your finger around a group of buttons. Lift your finger to complete the lasso.
Depressed Shift Kwy is a memory which preserves Button selections and deselections, even across multiple pages.
